name: Blender first launch: install, preferences, viewport navigation, Move/Rotate/Scale
goal: Install Blender, set useful preferences (Resolution Scale, GPU/CUDA Cycles device, Undo Steps, Save Preferences), navigate the viewport with MMB orbit / Shift+MMB pan / scroll zoom and numpad or Alt+MMB orthographic snaps, then transform the default cube with the Move/Rotate/Scale tools and G/R/S hotkeys with X/Y/Z axis locks.

sources.title: ABSOLUTE Beginner Basics.. Blender For Noobs 2025

prerequisites: Mouse with middle button / scroll wheel preferred (three-button mouse)

inputs.name: scene
inputs.description: Default scene with the cube (or any object)

outputs.name: configured_blender
outputs.description: Blender with saved prefs and basic nav competence

outputs.name: transformed_cube
outputs.description: Default cube moved/rotated/scaled via tools and hotkeys

constraints: Middle mouse button (MMB) scroll zooms; MMB drag orbits
Numpad 1/3/7/9 for front/right/top/bottom ortho; without numpad use Alt+MMB drag to snap views
Edit→Preferences→Resolution Scale e.g. 1.25 if UI too small
Tab toggles Object/Edit; T toggles toolbar; N toggles sidebar

steps.action: Download Blender from blender.org and install for your OS; open and click outside splash to dismiss.
Edit → Preferences → Interface: adjust Resolution Scale (e.g. 1.25) if UI is tiny/huge.
Preferences → System: enable CUDA/GPU Cycles device if available; raise Undo Steps (e.g. 100); Save Preferences.
steps.expect: GPU device/undo steps saved in prefs

steps.action: Without a middle mouse button / on trackpad: enable Emulate 3 Button Mouse or use trackpad alternatives.
Scroll the middle mouse wheel to zoom in and out.
Click and drag the middle mouse button to orbit around the object.
Hold Shift and middle-mouse-drag to pan the scene. Optional: viewport gizmo orbit/zoom/pan.
If you have a numpad: 1 front orthographic, 3 right, 7 top, 9 bottom.
Without a numpad: hold Alt, middle-mouse-drag toward the desired axis to snap orthographic views. Or click gizmo axes for axis views.
Activate Move tool; drag RGB handles to move the cube.
Activate Rotate tool; drag handles to rotate.
Activate Scale tool; drag the white uniform handle to scale on all axes.
Use hotkeys G, R, S for Move/Rotate/Scale; axis-constrain with X/Y/Z; Tab for Edit mode.
steps.expect: G/R/S with axis lock work; Tab enters Edit mode

verification: Can orbit/pan/zoom and G/R/S the default cube
Cube transformed with all three tools
Can orbit, pan, and zoom without using toolbar gizmo icons
